summary: Connect independent binary trial paths to exact probabilities and observed counts.
objective: Build a binomial trial lattice with editable trial count and success probability, exact probability bars and seeded sample paths.
intent_signals: Build a binomial trial lattice with editable trial count and success probability, exact probability bars and seeded sample paths.
Connect independent binary trial paths to exact probabilities and observed counts.
example_prompts: Build a binomial trial lattice with editable trial count and success probability, exact probability bars and seeded sample paths.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of binomial distribution with sample inspector.
negative_signals: This lattice is not a simulated Galton board; no contact physics or fairness inference from a rendered path.
not_for: This lattice is not a simulated Galton board; no contact physics or fairness inference from a rendered path.

entities.name: Trial lattice
entities.guidance: Place nodes by trial number and successes; use depth only to separate highlighted paths, not as a probability dimension.

entities.name: Outcome bars
entities.guidance: Display k=0..n with equal-width bars whose heights encode probability mass; overlay empirical relative frequency with a different mark style.

entities.name: Sample inspector
entities.guidance: Show selected trial outcomes, seed, number of completed samples and expected count n*p.

state_contract.model: Integer n in [1,20], probability p in [0,1]; X counts successes in n independent Bernoulli trials. Compute the exact PMF, handling p=0 and p=1 explicitly.
state_contract.authority: An immutable seeded trial sequence owns sample outcomes; lattice nodes represent (trial index,success count), not physical ball collisions.
actions: Set n and p, clearing incompatible sample history.
Generate one sample or a bounded batch from the current seed.

invariants: Exact masses sum to one within numerical tolerance.
At p=0 all mass is at k=0; at p=1 all mass is at k=n.
Empirical counts sum to completed samples; playback never generates new random outcomes.
motion_guidance: Animate a marker along its precomputed branch choices; visual speed does not affect likelihood.
Pause between or within trace steps without consuming random numbers.
known_limits: This lattice is not a simulated Galton board; no contact physics or fairness inference from a rendered path.
Finite sample frequencies fluctuate and need not match exact probabilities.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: A binomial variable counts successes in a fixed number of independent two-outcome trials with constant success probability.
claims.scope: The experiment must satisfy the binomial assumptions; n and p are declared inputs.

source_refs.locator: 4.3, binomial experiment criteria and distribution formula

object_craft.structure: Place nodes by trial number and successes; use depth only to separate highlighted paths, not as a probability dimension.
object_craft.material: Matte node tokens and thin branch rails; use labels for success/failure and a common vertical probability scale.
